metadata.method: Normalised current OSM water and power context for OpenCityLog utility lens rendering. Dated event records still drive year-specific changes.
caveats: OSM mapped visibility is not a confirmed installation/opening date.
The artifact does not contain measured utility capacity, outage state, or service availability.
Water features include mapped waterways/water bodies where available; they are context geometry, not surveyed water-main records.
